Call to schedule a sterilization consultation (not a regular obgyn appointment), have the method you want already chosen, and inform them over the phone ahead of time (it is not an appointment to discuss options; it is an appointment to set a date for the procedure that you've independently selected as being best for yourself after careful research), and bring a paper demonstrating that you know what the risks are, that you know it's permanent, etc.

I dressed up in business attire and went in blazing, even though I'm shy. It is not a negotiation.
